scaleDisclaimer: A tier measures how much an outsider can check, not whether the system is safe, solvent or well-run. V3 means the check has been proven able to fail — not that nothing will.
subject: FXRP agent backing
name: RECONCILED
meaning: Two independent sources are compared, and a disagreement between them would be detected.

criteria.requires: The facts can be read from public sources by someone with no relationship to the subject.
criteria.because: all 6 FXRP agents read from Flare's AssetManager and public XRP Ledger servers, no credentials

criteria.requires: At least two sources are read, and neither can determine what the other says.
criteria.because: Flare's AssetManager records underlyingBalanceUBA; the XRP Ledger holds the balance. Neither determines what the other reports

criteria.requires: A disagreement between those sources would change the published verdict.
criteria.because: a shortfall surviving all 3 readings of the settle bracket is published as EXCEPTION; one that resolves is a DISCLAIMER naming the skew

criteria.requires: A fault has been deliberately injected and the check caught it, within 30 days.
criteria.because: no falsification on record — the check has never been shown able to fail
